# Organs The torso holds the heart and lungs. The groin holds the liver, stomach and kidneys. The head holds the brain and eyes.
## Organ damage Heavy hits can damage the organs inside a part. While they are damaged, that part won't heal. Open the part that holds them and run [color=#a4885c]Heal Organs[/color] until the damage is gone, then close up.
## Transplants To swap an organ, open the part that holds it, run the matching [color=#a4885c]Remove[/color] operation, then the matching [color=#a4885c]Insert[/color] operation while holding the new organ.
